research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: ALT TEX is engaged in developing textiles derived from food waste, as described in 'Textiles derived from food waste and processes of making thereof.' The abstract details methods for converting food waste into polymers such as poly(lactic) acid, incorporating additives, and producing biodegradable products. Their research and development focus on transforming post-industrial food waste into sustainable, carbon-neutral fabrics through enzymatic hydrolysis and fermentation.
